dispatches.headline: Reconciliation desk moves to a standing agent review
dispatches.dek: A recurring ledger-matching function is reassigned to an always-on review agent; the desk shifts to exception handling only.

dispatches.headline: Category analyst role folded into a forecasting copilot
dispatches.dek: Weekly category reporting is generated automatically; the analyst role shifts toward exception review and vendor negotiation.

dispatches.headline: Store-ops scheduling department absorbs a demand-forecast agent
dispatches.dek: Shift scheduling and demand forecasting merge under one system; the department retains oversight and escalation.

dispatches.headline: Tier-1 support queue triaged entirely by agent before escalation
dispatches.dek: First-response triage and routing is fully automated; the human queue starts at tier-2.

dispatches.headline: Adverse-event coding role augmented with a review agent
dispatches.dek: Coding throughput roughly doubles; a licensed reviewer remains the sign-off authority on every case.

dispatches.headline: Metadata tagging function moves off a contractor pool
dispatches.dek: Catalog tagging for new releases is generated automatically and spot-checked by an in-house editor.

dispatches.headline: Parts-compliance documentation role reclaims review capacity
dispatches.dek: Cross-referencing supplier certifications against spec is automated; the compliance role shifts to audits and exceptions.

dispatches.headline: Warranty-claim intake role shifts to adjudication review
dispatches.dek: Claim intake and initial validation run automatically; the role retains the adjudication decision.

dispatches.headline: Maintenance-scheduling department pilots a predictive agent
dispatches.dek: Work-order prioritization is proposed by the agent and confirmed by the floor lead each shift.

dispatches.headline: Board adds a standing review committee for agent-assisted underwriting
dispatches.dek: A quarterly governance committee is formed to audit underwriting decisions made with agent assistance.

dispatches.headline: Enterprise-wide governance controls added ahead of a phased rollout
dispatches.dek: A cross-functional review gate is established before any new agent workflow ships to a live desk.

dispatches.headline: Enterprise forecasting rollout reclaims capacity across three regions
dispatches.dek: The regional pilot's forecasting copilot is extended company-wide; savings compound across desks.
